sloka: अब्रवीच्च तदा रामः सुग्रीवं प्रत्यनन्तरम्।विभीषणं च धर्मात्मा हनूमन्तं च वानरम् ।। ६.९४.३७ ।।
transliteration: abravīcca tadā rāmaḥ sugrīvaṁ pratyanantaram।vibhīṣaṇaṁ ca dharmātmā hanūmantaṁ ca vānaram ।। 6.94.37 ।।

translations.english: Then righteous Sri Rama said to nearby Sugriva, Vibheeshana, Hanuman, Jambavan and leaders of Vanaras like Mainda, Dwivida, that the power of these arrows are in him and Lord Siva only.
